test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Arrange the following in a logical and meaningful order.

I. Kamet

II. Kanchenjunga

III. Nanda Devi

IV. Saltoro Kangri
solution:
**This mountain ranges are arranged according to their location from North to South:-**

__**Key Points:**__

IV. Saltoro Kangri → ​It is located near the Siachen region, Northwest India. 

I. Kamet → It is the mountain peak of the Himalayas in Uttarakhand, northern India after Nanda Devi.

III. Nanda Devi → It is the mountain peak of the Himalayas in Uttarakhand, northern India.

II. Kanchenjunga → ​It is located Nepali Kumbhkaran Lungur, East india. 

__**Additional Information**__

 
• **Nanda Devi (7816 metres):**

 
 
• It is a part of Himalayan mountain ranges (Garhwal).
 
• This is the highest peak located entirely within India.
 
• The Nanda Devi National Prak, located in vicinity to the peak, consists of the best high altitude flora and fauna.
 
 
 
• **Kamet (7,756 metres):**
 
 
• **​**Kamet, mountain peak of the Himalayas in **Uttarakhand state**, northern India, **near the border with the Tibet Autonomous Region of China**.
 
• It is part of the **Zaskar range**.
 
 
 
• **Saltoro Kangri (7742 meters):**
 
 
• **​**It is located **near the Siachen Region**.
 
• The Saltoro Kangri is ranked the** 31st highest independent peak in the world**.
 
• It **lies in Saltoro range** (a part of **Karakoram Mountain range**)
 
 
 
• **Kanchenjunga (****8,586 metres****):**
 
 
• **​**It is located in Nepali **Kumbhkaran Lungur**.
 
• The **Kanchenjunga** is ranked the world’s third-highest mountain.
 
• It is a part of the Great Himalaya Range.
 
 

Hence, The correct logical arrangement is “IV, l, III, II”
